input.summary: Insert express Customer Data return and certified deletion obligation in Section 11.4
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.4 gives us transition assistance but no express right to get our data back, so we have added return of Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within thirty (30) days and certified deletion thereafter, consistent with our ownership of Customer Data under Section 17.1.

ops.text: 11.5 Return of Customer Data. Upon expiration or any termination of this Agreement for any reason, and in any event within thirty (30) days following the Effective Date of Termination (or, if later, the end of any Termination Assistance period), M&I shall return to Customer all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format, and shall thereafter delete all Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
